concept.title: Whispers over Thallorwood
concept.logline: On fog-bound, cozy Thallorwood, you scour every corner to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.
concept.source_prompt: Pine Valley. forest woods pine valley collectathon Relic hunt
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Mossbrook Camp and becomes the one who brings the Moon Shrine back to life.

key_locations.name: Mossbrook Camp
key_locations.description: The start: a ring of tents around a fire pit.

key_locations.name: Treetop Village
key_locations.description: Treetop Village: a village of Thallorwood, reached by the trail from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Woodcutter Camp
key_locations.description: Woodcutter Camp: a camp on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Overgrown Keep
key_locations.description: Overgrown Keep: a ruin of Thallorwood, reached by the trail from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Ranger Tower
key_locations.description: Ranger Tower: a tower on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

key_locations.name: Moon Shrine
key_locations.description: Moon Shrine: the far end of the hub and spokes, where the story ends.

characters.name: Elder Nadia
characters.description: Waits in Mossbrook Camp and knows why the Moon Shrine fell silent.

characters.name: Juno the Scout
characters.description: Follows you from Mossbrook Camp and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Thorn Wolf
characters.description: A thorn wolf that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Bramble Sentinel
characters.description: A bramble sentinel that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Oak Warden
characters.description: A oak warden that never leaves its post, but lunges at anyone who gets close.

characters.name: Bram the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Thallorwood for anything shiny.

characters.name: Moss Hare
characters.description: A harmless moss hare that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Find every relic, in any order
Bonus: make offerings at the sites
hazards: Thorn Wolf hunting near its lair
Bramble Sentinel patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On fog-bound, cozy Thallorwood, you scour every corner to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.
5 relics are scattered across Whispers over Thallorwood. Find them all, in any order.
Relic secured: the Treetop Village Herb.
Relic secured: the Woodcutter Camp Herb.
Relic secured: the Overgrown Keep Herb.
Relic secured: the Ranger Tower Herb.
Relic secured: the Moon Shrine Herb.
Every relic is home. The hunt is over.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Elder Nadia
nodes.text: So you've come to Mossbrook Camp at last. I am Elder Nadia. On fog-bound, cozy Thallorwood, you scour every corner to recover the seed relics and restore the Moon Shrine.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Elder Nadia
nodes.text: Back again. Mossbrook Camp is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Elder Nadia
nodes.text: Go to Treetop Village, then Woodcutter Camp. Whatever still remembers Whispers over Thallorwood is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Elder Nadia
nodes.text: They say Mossbrook Camp was built on what was left of an older place. Serene, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Elder Nadia
nodes.text: Treetop Village: Treetop Village: a village of Thallorwood, reached by the trail from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Elder Nadia
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Whispers over Thallorwood back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Elder Nadia
nodes.text: Woodcutter Camp: Woodcutter Camp: a camp on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Scout
nodes.text: Juno the Scout circles your feet, then looks toward Ranger Tower as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Scout
nodes.text: Juno the Scout sniffs the air. Something about Ranger Tower has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Juno the Scout
nodes.text: It turns toward Ranger Tower. Ranger Tower: a tower on the way out from Mossbrook Camp.

nodes.speaker: Thorn Wolf
nodes.text: The thorn wolf watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Oak Warden
nodes.text: Halt. Oak Warden, of the watch at Mossbrook Camp. Keep to the paths out there.

nodes.speaker: Oak Warden
nodes.text: Still in one piece? Good. Keep it that way.

nodes.speaker: Oak Warden
nodes.text: Thorn Wolf hunting near its lair. Worst near Treetop Village.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Mossbrook Camp. Bram the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Whispers over Thallorwood that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Bram the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Treetop Village after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Moss Hare
nodes.text: The moss hare freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
